reason: The premise states that Philip Morris's foray into Lithuania in April and the negative impact of advertising restrictions on sales lead to the conclusion that selling 201 billion cigarettes indicates high demand. This is contradictory because if advertising restrictions negatively impact sales, it undermines the claim of high demand indicated by the sales figure.
refined_position: Causal contradiction - the negative impact of advertising restrictions on sales contradicts the assertion that high sales figures indicate high demand.
reflecting_rules: - 3. Q[Philip_Morris, Advertising_Restrictions](Philip_Morris.foray_into Lithuania in April ∧ Advertising_Restrictions impact sales negatively → Philip_Morris.sold 201 billion cigarettes indicates high_demand)
